name: codeflow
description: Understand unfamiliar C++ and JavaScript code through progressive, source-linked visualization.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: CodeFlow activates in Restricted Mode and can render its built-in demonstration graph. It does not read workspace files or start processes in this phase.

codeflow.logLevel.description: Verbosity of the CodeFlow output channel. Debug adds timings and protocol traces but never source text.

codeflow.protocol.traceMessages.description: Log webview protocol message kinds and sizes at debug level. Payload contents are never logged.

codeflow.explorer.retainContext.description: Keep the CodeFlow webview alive when hidden. Disabled by default to reduce memory use; re-rendering is cheap.

codeflow.cpp.clangPath.description: Absolute path to clang or clang++. When empty, CodeFlow probes PATH and the platform's common locations. It never runs a build system.

codeflow.cpp.compileCommandsPath.description: Path to a compile_commands.json. When empty, CodeFlow searches the workspace root, build/, cmake-build-* and out/.

codeflow.cpp.fallbackIncludePaths.description: Include paths used only when no compilation database entry covers a file. Results in this mode are always partial.

codeflow.cpp.fallbackDefines.description: Preprocessor defines used only in heuristic mode, for example DEBUG or NAME=1.

codeflow.cpp.fallbackStandard.description: Language standard used in heuristic mode, for example c++17 or c++20. Empty lets CodeFlow choose from the file extension.

codeflow.cpp.timeoutMs.description: Time budget for one Clang invocation. Exceeding it produces a partial run, never a frozen window.

codeflow.cpp.maxOutputBytes.description: Maximum Clang stdout/stderr size. A larger AST produces a partial run with a diagnostic.

codeflow.cpp.maxFileBytes.description: Maximum source file size CodeFlow will read for one translation unit.

codeflow.javascript.resolveNodeModules.description: Resolve package imports through the workspace node_modules directory. Disabled by default so analysis stays inside workspace source.

codeflow.javascript.includeWorkspaceGlob.description: Discover sibling JavaScript files in the same directory during single-file analysis so classic non-module scripts resolve cross-file calls.

codeflow.javascript.maxFileBytes.description: Maximum JavaScript file size CodeFlow will read, including imported modules.

codeflow.javascript.maxLines.description: Files with more lines are analysed for syntax and declarations only and marked partial.

codeflow.javascript.maxModules.description: Maximum number of modules read while following imports. Further imports become unresolved with a budget diagnostic.

codeflow.javascript.maxDepth.description: Maximum import depth followed from the analysed file.

codeflow.preview.enabled.description: Show a source preview when hovering a graph node. The preview is always a slice of the real document, never a reconstruction.

codeflow.preview.delayMs.description: Hover dwell time before the source preview appears. Lower values feel faster; higher values flicker less while scanning.

codeflow.preview.maxLines.description: Maximum number of source lines shown in a preview card. Longer ranges are truncated with a visible note.

codeflow.preview.syntaxHighlighting.description: Highlight preview source in the webview. Disabling it keeps previews readable when a language is unrecognized or performance is a concern.

codeflow.preview.clickToNavigate.description: Open the source range in the editor when a graph node is double-clicked or activated with Enter.

codeflow.preview.pinByDefault.description: Keep a hover preview open until it is dismissed instead of hiding when the pointer leaves.

codeflow.navigation.openInPreviewTab.description: Open source navigation targets in a preview tab. Disabled by default so trust-building navigation does not replace the current editor.

codeflow.explanation.defaultDepth.description: Default explanation depth level (1 Basic, 2 Intermediate, 3 Advanced, 4 Deep).

codeflow.explanation.showEvidence.description: Show source and semantic evidence links under explanations.

codeflow.explanation.includeLimitations.description: Expand analysis limitation disclosures by default. Limitations remain accessible for honesty even when collapsed.

codeflow.index.debounceMs.description: Per-document debounce delay in milliseconds before incremental index analysis runs after an edit.

codeflow.index.promptOnOpen.description: Offer optional repository-wide indexing when opening CodeFlow on an unindexed workspace.

codeflow.index.autoUpdate.description: Incrementally update the repository index when workspace files change.

codeflow.index.maxFileBytes.description: Maximum individual source file size in bytes included during repository-wide indexing.

editor/title.when: editorLangId == javascript || editorLangId == javascriptreact || editorLangId == cpp || editorLangId == c || editorLangId == java
